reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Revert \"docs: Add deployment for AWS NLB Proxy.\"", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Reverting a documentation addition (the AWS NLB Proxy deployment docs) has no operational consequence for an operator.

proposed.statement: A documentation change that added a deployment for AWS NLB Proxy was reverted; it has no stated operational effect on the controller.
